newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar settles firmer and near highs.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar settles firmer and near highs.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures closed firmer and over key resistance, suggesting that follow-through fund buying on Monday could fuel the benchmark October contract toward its next upside target, dealers said.
An early move over resistance at 11.22 cents in October was met by producer scale-up selling which knocked the market off the highs.

Steady producer selling coupled with light local liquidation kept the contract close to unchanged for most of the day. A late-session push by the funds fueled the most-active month toward the high by the close, traders said.
The October contract ended 0.12 cent higher at 11.28 cents per lb, having ranged from 11.29 to 11.16 cents. Second-position March also settled 0.12 cent firmer at 11.47.
Several of the deferred months climbed to new, life-of-contract highs during the session.
Market sources said prices could remain trapped in their recent range until the October contract pierces 11.40 cents, the recent high reached on July 1.
The next upside target was seen at 11.50 cents.
A move under 10.90 cents in October could attract heavy fund selling and pressure the contract to its next downside target of 10.80 cents, they said.
An estimated 13,010 lots changed hands on the day, compared with Thursday's official 14,680 lots.
Open interest in the most-active October contract fell by 433 lots to 91,557 lots as of Thursday.
